name: Street Ball Star
author: Addicting Games
description: Street Ball Star is a free basketball game. Get ready to live out your hoop dreams in this fantastic physics simulator. This is a basketball game that is set on the streets, not a fancy basketball court, but maybe if you ball hard enough, sharpen your short throws and keep your eye on the ball you'll make it to the big leagues. Street Ball Star is a physics game that tests your ability to aim a ball from the floor of the court to the rim of the basket. You'll have to learn the physics of the world as your grapple with gravity trying to pull the ball away from the net. This game doesn't just test your skills but it helps you work on them as you play. You'll be able to hone your instincts as your shoot for glory in this thrilling basketball simulator. One of our personal favorite sports games and possibly one of the best out there. Many people are saying it, you're hearing it more and more: Street Ball Star is a game for heroes on the court and beyond the keyboard.
